player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} ({piece}). Opponent is ({opp}). Submit moves as '[b1 c3]' (from → to). All pieces move like chess knights.
Each capture scores {score_per_capture} point. Game ends after {max_moves} moves or when a player has no legal move / no pieces. Higher score wins.

invalid_move.bad_format: He hōputu hē. Whakamahia te '[b1 c3]'.
invalid_move.not_your_piece: Ehara i te mea ko koe te pūtake.
invalid_move.own_piece: Kāore e taea te tū ki runga i tōu ake papa.

game_action.moved: I nekehia e te kaitākaro {player_id} tana pihi mai i {frm} ki {to}.

outcome.no_pieces: Kāore he tākaro o te kaitakaro {player_id}.
outcome.cannot_move: Kāore e taea te neke a {player_id} kaitākaro.
outcome.higher_score: He nui ake te whiwhinga hopu.
outcome.move_limit: Kua tae ki te rohe nekehanga.
